passages.title: RM 在聯合國的演講
passages.text: In September 2018, BTS became the first K-pop group to speak at the United Nations. Last week, our English teacher played the video in our {1}. RM, the leader of the group, gave the speech in English. He said he was born in Ilsan, a city near Seoul. He also said that when he was nine or ten, he started to worry about what other people thought of him. At the end, he asked young people around the world to "speak yourself." After the video, our teacher gave each of us a {2} of paper and asked us to write about ourselves in English. My friend Kevin wrote about his love for basketball and the long hours he spends in the school {3}. I wrote about my dream of becoming a writer. The next week, our {4} put some of our papers on the wall outside the school {5}. Mine was one of them!

blanks.why: in our classroom「在我們的教室裡」播影片。fever（發燒）、sugar（糖）、weather（天氣）都不是可以播放影片的地點。
a piece of paper「一張紙」，piece 是計算紙張的單位。fever、noise（噪音）、cough（咳嗽）都不能和 of paper 搭配。
in the school gym「在學校體育館」練籃球。sugar、cough、receipt（收據）都不是打球的地方。
our principal「我們的校長」把作文貼到牆上，要用「人」當主詞。pumpkin（南瓜）、receipt、weather 都不會做這件事。
outside the school library「學校圖書館外面」。fever、noise、sugar 都不是地點，不能接在 the school 後面當場所。

gloss: 防彈少年團隊長（本名金南俊）
passages.zh: 2018 年 9 月，防彈少年團成為第一個在聯合國發表演說的韓國流行音樂團體。上星期，我們的英文老師在教室裡播放了那段影片。團長 RM 用英文發表演講。他說自己出生在首爾附近的城市一山。他也說，在他九歲或十歲的時候，開始擔心別人怎麼看他。最後，他請世界各地的年輕人「說出你自己」。看完影片後，老師發給我們每人一張紙，要我們用英文寫自己的事。我的朋友凱文寫他多愛籃球，以及他在學校體育館花的好幾個小時。我寫的是想成為作家的夢想。下一週，校長把我們一些人的作文貼在學校圖書館外的牆上，我的也是其中一篇！

passages.title: 防彈少年團的學校三部曲
passages.text: Did you know that BTS's first songs were about school life? The group debuted on June 13, 2013, with the song "No More Dream" from their first album, 2 Cool 4 Skool. The song asks young people a big question: "What is your own dream?" Many Korean students at that time spent long hours studying in the {1} or at cram school, and they felt the song understood them. Fans now call BTS's first three albums the "School Trilogy," because the songs are about students' lives, dreams, and love. Last month, our school held a talent show in the {2}. My class practiced in our {3} every day after lunch. On the big day, we danced to "No More Dream," and everyone wore their school {4}. Even our {5} stood up and clapped along!

blanks.why: studying in the library「在圖書館讀書」。weather、fever、sugar 都不是可以讀書的地方。
held a talent show in the gym「在體育館舉辦才藝表演」。noise、sugar、fever 都不是可以辦活動的場地。
practiced in our classroom「在我們的教室練習」。cough、pumpkin、fever 都不是練舞的地點。
wore their school uniforms「穿著學校制服」，wear 的受詞是衣物。fevers、coughs、receipts 都不能「穿」。
our principal stood up「校長站起來」跟著拍手，主詞要是人。pumpkin、weather、noise 都不會站起來拍手。

passages.zh: 你知道防彈少年團最早的歌是在講校園生活嗎？他們在 2013 年 6 月 13 日出道，出道曲是第一張專輯《2 Cool 4 Skool》裡的〈No More Dream〉。這首歌問年輕人一個大問題：「你自己的夢想是什麼？」當時很多韓國學生每天花很長的時間在圖書館或補習班讀書，他們覺得這首歌懂他們的心情。粉絲現在把防彈少年團的前三張專輯叫做「學校三部曲」，因為歌曲講的是學生的生活、夢想和愛情。上個月，我們學校在體育館辦才藝表演。我們班每天午餐後都在教室裡練習。到了表演那天，我們跳〈No More Dream〉，每個人都穿著學校制服。連校長都站起來跟著拍手！

passages.title: SEVENTEEN 在聯合國教科文組織
passages.text: In November 2023, SEVENTEEN became the first K-pop group to speak and perform at the UNESCO Youth Forum in Paris. UNESCO works for education around the world, so the members talked about a big problem: many children still cannot go to school. My cousin is a huge fan, and she {1} me the video in the school {2} during lunch break. Six members spoke for the group. They said they grew by teaching and learning from each other. They also told the audience that money from their fans and their world tour helped {3} a school in Malawi, a country in Africa. After watching the video, my cousin had an idea. She went to see our {4} and asked if our class could collect old books for a school far away. He said yes right away. Now there is a big box next to our {5} door, and it is already half full.

blanks.why: showed me the video「給我看影片」，show + 人 + 東西。arrived、slept、cried 都是不能接受詞的動詞，不能說 arrived me the video。
in the school library「在學校圖書館」午休時看影片。fever、cough、noise 都不是地點。
helped build a school「幫忙蓋一所學校」，help 後面可以直接接原形動詞。arrive、cry、sleep 都不能接受詞 a school。
went to see our principal「去見校長」，見的對象是人，後面的 He said yes 也指校長。weather、pumpkin、sugar 都不能「去見」。
next to our classroom door「在我們教室門旁」。fever、sugar、cough 都不能用來說明是哪一扇門。

passages.zh: 2023 年 11 月，SEVENTEEN 成為第一個在巴黎聯合國教科文組織青年論壇上演講和表演的韓國流行音樂團體。教科文組織為全世界的教育努力，所以成員們談到一個大問題：還有很多孩子不能上學。我表姊是超級粉絲，她午休時在學校圖書館給我看那段影片。六位成員代表團體發言。他們說自己是靠著互相教、互相學而成長的。他們也告訴聽眾，粉絲捐的錢和世界巡演的收入，幫忙在非洲國家馬拉威蓋了一所學校。看完影片後，表姊想到一個點子。她去見校長，問我們班能不能為遠方的學校收集舊書。校長馬上就答應了。現在我們教室門旁有一個大箱子，已經裝了一半了。

passages.title: ILLIT 的〈Magnetic〉
passages.text: ILLIT is a girl group that debuted in March 2024. Their first song, "Magnetic," became popular very quickly. In April 2024, it entered the Billboard Hot 100 chart in the US. It was the first time a K-pop group's debut song made it onto that chart. The dance for "Magnetic" is cute and not too hard, so students everywhere copied it. At our school, girls practiced it on the {1} during every break. Some boys joined them too, but they were not very good. One day, Ms. Lin, our music teacher, said we could perform it at the school's New Year party in the {2}. Our whole class practiced in the {3} after school for two weeks. On the day of the party, we were all nervous. But when the music started, everyone {4}. Even our {5} tried to do the dance!

blanks.why: practiced it on the playground「在操場上練」。fever、sugar、cough 都不是可以跳舞的地方。
the New Year party in the gym「在體育館辦的新年派對」。weather、noise、receipt 都不是場地。
practiced in the classroom「在教室練習」。pumpkin、fever、sugar 都不是地點。
everyone cheered「大家都歡呼」，音樂一開始全場熱烈回應。boiled（煮沸）、borrowed（借）、baked（烘烤）放在這裡完全不合情境，而且 borrow、bake 後面要接東西。
our principal tried to do the dance「校長也試著跳這支舞」，主詞要是人。noise、weather、sugar 都不會跳舞。

gloss: 美國告示牌百大單曲榜
passages.zh: ILLIT 是 2024 年 3 月出道的女團。她們的第一首歌〈Magnetic〉很快就紅了。2024 年 4 月，這首歌登上美國告示牌百大單曲榜。這是韓國流行音樂團體的出道曲第一次登上這個排行榜。〈Magnetic〉的舞步很可愛又不會太難，所以到處都有學生在模仿。在我們學校，女生每節下課都在操場上練。有些男生也加入了，但跳得不太好。有一天，音樂課的林老師說我們可以在體育館的學校新年派對上表演。全班放學後在教室裡練了兩個星期。派對那天，我們都很緊張。但音樂一開始，大家都歡呼起來。連校長都試著跳這支舞！

passages.title: BLACKPINK 站上科切拉
passages.text: Coachella is one of the most famous music festivals in the world. It takes place in the California desert every April. In 2019, BLACKPINK became the first K-pop girl group to perform there. Four years later, in 2023, they came back as headliners, the main stars of the night. They were the first Asian act ever to headline the festival. My sister watched the show online again and again until late at night. The next morning, she fell asleep in her {1} during math class! Her teacher was not happy and sent her to the {2}'s office. "Why are you so {3} today?" the principal asked. My sister told him the truth. He laughed and said, "My daughter is a big fan too." Then he told her to go to the school {4} and write a report about BLACKPINK in English. She wrote three pages and got the highest {5} in her class.

blanks.why: fell asleep in her classroom「在教室裡睡著」。sugar、fever、cough 都不是地點。
the principal's office「校長室」，被老師送去見校長。pumpkin、noise、weather 都沒有「辦公室」。
so tired「這麼累」，前一晚熬夜看表演，上課才會睡著。crowded（擁擠的）、salty（鹹的）、national（國家的）都不能形容人累不累。
go to the school library「去學校圖書館」寫報告。fever、cough、noise 都不是可以去的地方。
got the highest grade「拿到最高分」。fever、noise、sugar 都不能說「拿到最高的」來表示成績。

passages.zh: 科切拉是世界上最有名的音樂節之一，每年四月在加州的沙漠舉行。2019 年，BLACKPINK 成為第一個在那裡表演的韓國流行音樂女團。四年後的 2023 年，她們以壓軸主秀的身分回來，成為當晚最重要的明星。她們是第一組擔任這個音樂節壓軸的亞洲藝人。我姊姊在網路上把那場表演看了一遍又一遍，直到深夜。隔天早上，她在數學課時在教室裡睡著了！老師很不高興，叫她去校長室。「你今天怎麼這麼累？」校長問。姊姊說了實話。校長笑著說：「我女兒也是她們的大粉絲。」接著他要姊姊去學校圖書館，用英文寫一篇關於 BLACKPINK 的報告。她寫了三頁，拿到全班最高分。

passages.title: 防彈少年團的《Arirang》回歸
passages.text: For almost four years, the BTS members were busy with their own work and their military service. Then, on March 20, 2026, the group came back together with a new album called Arirang. The album went straight to No. 1 on the Billboard 200 chart in the US, and it stayed there for a second week. No K-pop act had ever been No. 1 on that chart for two weeks in a row. On the morning the album came out, my best friend Amy came to school with her headphones on. She listened to it in the {1} before the bell, at lunch, and even in the {2}, where she had to keep the music very low. After school, she played it again on her phone while we walked around the {3}. "Amy, you've played it twenty times today!" I said. She just smiled and {4} the music up. I {5} I will know every song by tomorrow.

blanks.why: in the classroom before the bell「上課鐘響前在教室裡」。cough、fever、sugar 都不是地點。
in the library, where she had to keep the music very low「在圖書館裡，所以音樂要開很小聲」。noise、pumpkin、weather 都不是地點，後面的 where 也接不上。
walked around the playground「繞著操場走」。fever、sugar、receipt 都不是可以繞著走的地方。
turned the music up「把音樂轉大聲」，turn up 是固定片語。borrowed、baked、married 都不能和 up 搭配成「調大聲」的意思。
I guess「我猜」，後面接一個句子表示推測。boil（煮沸）、marry（結婚）、bake（烤）都不能接 I will know every song 這樣的句子。

gloss: 美國告示牌兩百大專輯榜
passages.zh: 將近四年的時間，防彈少年團的成員們忙著各自的工作和服兵役。然後在 2026 年 3 月 20 日，他們帶著新專輯《Arirang》一起回歸了。這張專輯一推出就登上美國告示牌兩百大專輯榜第一名，而且第二週還是第一名。以前從來沒有韓國流行音樂藝人連續兩週拿下這個榜的冠軍。專輯推出那天早上，我最好的朋友艾咪戴著耳機來上學。她上課鐘響前在教室裡聽、午餐時聽，連在圖書館裡也聽，只是音樂得開得很小聲。放學後我們繞著操場散步時，她又用手機放了一次。「艾咪，你今天已經放二十遍了！」我說。她只是笑一笑，把音樂調得更大聲。我猜明天我就會每一首都會唱了。

passages.title: 大谷翔平的目標表
passages.text: When Shohei Ohtani was in his first year at Hanamaki Higashi High School in Japan, he made a special goal chart. In the center, he wrote his big dream: to be the top draft pick of eight pro baseball teams. Around it, he wrote the things he needed, like ball control, physical fitness, mental strength, and even luck. Years later, in 2024, Ohtani became the first player in MLB history to {1} 50 home runs and steal 50 bases in one season. Now his chart is famous around the world. Last week, our homeroom teacher showed us a picture of it in our {2}. Then she asked us to make our own. My friend Leo wants to make the school basketball team, so he wrote "practice in the {3} every morning" in one box. I want to read fifty books this year, so I wrote "visit the {4} twice a week." Our teacher put all the charts on the wall. When the {5} walked by, he stopped and read every one.

blanks.why: hit 50 home runs「擊出 50 支全壘打」，hit 是打擊。borrow（借）、marry（結婚）、bake（烤）都不能和 home runs 搭配。
showed us a picture in our classroom「在教室裡給我們看照片」。fever、sugar、noise 都不是地點。
practice in the gym「在體育館練習」，籃球隊練球的地方。weather、cough、pumpkin 都不是場地。
visit the library「去圖書館」借書、看書，才能讀五十本書。fever、sugar、cough 都不能「去拜訪」。
the principal walked by「校長走過」，主詞要是會走路、會看的人。noise、pumpkin、weather 都不會走過來讀表格。

passages.zh: 大谷翔平在日本花卷東高中一年級時，做了一張特別的目標表。他在正中間寫下自己的大夢想：被八支職棒球隊在選秀中第一指名。在周圍，他寫下達成夢想需要的東西，例如控球、體能、心理素質，甚至還有運氣。多年後的 2024 年，大谷成為大聯盟史上第一位在同一季擊出 50 支全壘打、又盜壘 50 次的球員。現在他的目標表全世界都知道。上星期，班導在教室裡給我們看這張表的照片，然後要我們做自己的目標表。我的朋友里歐想進校隊打籃球，所以他在一格裡寫「每天早上去體育館練習」。我今年想讀五十本書，所以我寫「每週去圖書館兩次」。老師把所有的表都貼在牆上。校長經過時停下腳步，每一張都讀了。

passages.title: 帶著作業去歐洲盃
passages.text: In the summer of 2024, Lamine Yamal was only 16 years old, but he was already playing for Spain at the European Championship in Germany. He was still a secondary school student, so he brought his schoolwork with him. In his free time, he studied on an iPad in his room. During the tournament, he got good news: he {1} his exams. Then, in the semi-final against France, he scored an amazing goal and became the youngest goal scorer in the history of the tournament. Spain went on to win the whole thing. My little brother loves Yamal. He used to play soccer on the school {2} every day and forget about his homework. But after he read Yamal's story, he changed. Now he finishes his homework in the school {3} first and plays later. Last week, his teacher even put his homework on the wall of the {4} as a good example. When he told me, he looked as {5} as a World Cup winner.

blanks.why: passed his exams「通過考試」，pass 當及物動詞。arrived、cried、slept 都不能接受詞 his exams。
play soccer on the school playground「在學校操場踢足球」。fever、cough、sugar 都不是可以踢球的地方。
finishes his homework in the school library「在學校圖書館寫完作業」。weather、pumpkin、noise 都不是地點。
the wall of the classroom「教室的牆上」，老師把作業貼出來當範例。receipt、fever、sugar 都沒有牆可以貼作業。
as proud as「像……一樣驕傲」，被稱讚後很得意。crowded（擁擠的）、salty（鹹的）、sour（酸的）都不能形容人的心情。

passages.zh: 2024 年夏天，亞馬爾才 16 歲，就已經代表西班牙在德國參加歐洲國家盃。他當時還是中學生，所以把學校的功課一起帶去。空閒時間，他就在房間裡用 iPad 讀書。比賽期間，他得到好消息：他的考試通過了。後來在對法國的準決賽中，他踢進了一記漂亮的進球，成為這項賽事史上最年輕的進球球員。西班牙最後拿下了冠軍。我弟弟很喜歡亞馬爾。他以前每天在學校操場踢足球，把作業忘得一乾二淨。但讀了亞馬爾的故事後，他改變了。現在他先在學校圖書館寫完作業，之後才去玩。上星期，他的老師甚至把他的作業貼在教室牆上當範例。他告訴我的時候，看起來就像世界盃冠軍一樣得意。

passages.title: 被嫌太瘦的柯瑞
passages.text: Stephen Curry is one of the best shooters in basketball history. But in high school, he was small and thin, and most big college teams did not offer him a place. In the end, he went to Davidson College, a small school in North Carolina. In 2008, he led Davidson to the final eight teams of the national college tournament, and people began to notice him. In 2021, he broke the NBA record for the most three-pointers. Our PE teacher, Mr. Huang, loves telling this story. He says Curry spent many hours shooting in the {1} when nobody was watching. Last year, my friend Joe was the shortest boy on our class team. Every morning before class, he practiced shooting at the basket next to the {2}. At first, he missed almost every shot. But he never {3} up. This year, he made the winning basket in our school final. Our {4} handed him the trophy, and now it sits on a shelf in our {5}.

blanks.why: shooting in the gym「在體育館練投籃」。cough、sugar、weather 都不是地點。
the basket next to the playground「操場旁的籃框」。fever、receipt、pumpkin 都不是籃框旁邊會有的場地。
never gave up「從不放棄」，give up 是固定片語。boiled、borrowed、tasted 都不能和 up 組成「放棄」的意思。
our principal handed him the trophy「校長頒獎盃給他」，主詞要是人。noise、fever、sugar 都不會頒獎。
a shelf in our classroom「我們教室裡的架子」。cough、weather、pumpkin 裡面都不會有架子。

passages.zh: 史蒂芬．柯瑞是籃球史上最好的射手之一。但他高中時又矮又瘦，大部分大學強隊都沒有給他入隊的機會。最後，他去了北卡羅來納州的一所小學校——戴維森學院。2008 年，他帶領戴維森打進全國大學錦標賽的八強，大家才開始注意到他。2021 年，他打破了 NBA 三分球進球數的紀錄。我們的體育老師黃老師很愛講這個故事。他說柯瑞在沒人看的時候，花了好幾個小時在體育館練投籃。去年，我的朋友阿喬是我們班隊裡最矮的男生。每天早上上課前，他都在操場旁的籃框練投籃。一開始他幾乎每球都沒進，但他從不放棄。今年，他在校內決賽投進了致勝的一球。校長把獎盃頒給他，現在獎盃就放在我們教室的架子上。

passages.title: 麟洋配的兩面金牌
passages.text: In badminton, Lee Yang and Wang Chi-lin from Taiwan are a famous men's doubles pair. At the Tokyo Olympics in 2021, they won the gold medal. Three years later, at the Paris Olympics in 2024, they won it again. They became the first men's doubles pair in history to win two Olympic golds in a row. Since then, badminton has become very {1} at our school. Every day after lunch, students {2} to the {3} to get a court. There are only four courts, so the line is always long. Some students even tie a rope between two trees on the {4} and play there. Last month, our {5} bought twenty new rackets for the school badminton club. He also asked the club to teach younger students on Friday afternoons. Who knows? Maybe the next Olympic champion is in our school right now.

blanks.why: very popular「很受歡迎」，形容羽球這項運動。thirsty（口渴的）、sour（酸的）、careless（粗心的）都不能形容一項運動受不受歡迎。
hurry to the gym「趕去體育館」，hurry to + 地點。borrow、boil、marry 都不能接 to the gym 表示「趕去」。
to the gym to get a court「去體育館搶場地」，羽球場在體育館裡。fever、sugar、cough 都不是地點。
two trees on the playground「操場上的兩棵樹」。weather、receipt、noise 上面都不會長樹。
our principal bought new rackets「校長買了新球拍」，主詞要是人。pumpkin、noise、fever 都不會買東西。

passages.zh: 在羽球界，台灣的李洋和王齊麟是有名的男子雙打組合。他們在 2021 年的東京奧運拿下金牌。三年後，在 2024 年的巴黎奧運又拿到一次。他們成為史上第一對連續兩屆奧運奪金的男子雙打組合。從那時起，羽球在我們學校變得非常受歡迎。每天吃完午餐，學生們就趕去體育館搶場地。那裡只有四個球場，所以總是大排長龍。有些學生甚至在操場的兩棵樹之間綁一條繩子，在那裡打。上個月，校長幫學校羽球社買了二十支新球拍。他也請社團在星期五下午教學弟妹打球。誰知道呢？說不定下一位奧運冠軍現在就在我們學校裡。

passages.title: 籃球誕生的那個冬天
passages.text: In December 1891, a teacher named James Naismith had a problem. It was winter in Springfield, Massachusetts, and it was too cold to play outside. His students were {1} and full of energy, and they needed a game they could play inside the {2}. So Naismith hung two peach baskets at the two ends of the room and wrote 13 simple rules. The players had to throw a ball into the baskets. There was one funny problem: the baskets still had bottoms! Every time someone scored, a person had to climb up and {3} the ball out. Today, basketball is played all over the world. At our school, it is the most popular game on the {4}. When our {5} heard this story, he laughed and said, "Good thing our baskets have holes. Otherwise, I would need a very long ladder!"

blanks.why: were bored「覺得無聊」，冬天不能出去玩，學生精力旺盛卻沒事做。salty（鹹的）、crowded（擁擠的）、national（國家的）都不能形容學生的感覺。
play inside the gym「在體育館裡玩」，天氣冷只能在室內。fever、cough、sugar 都不是地點。
get the ball out「把球拿出來」，get + 東西 + out。boil、marry、cry 都不能表示把球拿出籃子。
the most popular game on the playground「操場上最受歡迎的遊戲」。weather、receipt、pumpkin 都不是可以打球的地方。
our principal heard this story「校長聽到這個故事」，主詞要是會聽、會笑的人。noise、fever、sugar 都不會聽故事。

gloss: 詹姆士．奈史密斯（籃球發明人）
passages.zh: 1891 年 12 月，一位叫詹姆士．奈史密斯的老師遇到一個難題。那時是麻薩諸塞州春田市的冬天，天氣冷得不能在外面運動。他的學生覺得很無聊又精力旺盛，需要一種能在體育館裡玩的遊戲。於是奈史密斯在場地兩端各掛了一個裝桃子的籃子，還寫了 13 條簡單的規則。球員要把球丟進籃子裡。不過有個好笑的問題：籃子還有底！每次有人得分，就得有人爬上去把球拿出來。如今，籃球在全世界都有人打。在我們學校，它是操場上最受歡迎的運動。校長聽到這個故事時笑著說：「還好我們的籃框有洞，不然我就需要一把很長的梯子了！」

passages.title: 排球原本叫什麼名字
passages.text: Volleyball was invented in 1895 by William G. Morgan, a PE teacher at a YMCA in Holyoke, Massachusetts. Just four years earlier, basketball had been invented in a town nearby. But Morgan felt that basketball was too rough for some of the older businessmen in his classes. He wanted a game with less running and pushing. So he put a net up high in the {1} and had players hit a ball over it with their hands. At first, he called the game "Mintonette," because it was a little like badminton. Later, people noticed that the players "volleyed" the ball back and forth, so the name {2} to "volleyball." I {3} this from a book in our school {4}. When I told my classmates in the {5}, nobody believed me. "Mintonette? That sounds like a kind of candy!" said Tony.

blanks.why: put a net up high in the gym「在體育館裡把網子架高」。cough、sugar、weather 都不是地點。
the name changed to「名字改成」，change 當不及物動詞。borrowed、baked、married 都不能表示名字改變。
learned this from a book「從一本書上學到這件事」，learn + 東西 + from。boiled、married、tasted 都不能接 this from a book。
a book in our school library「學校圖書館裡的書」。fever、noise、pumpkin 裡面都不會有書。
told my classmates in the classroom「在教室裡告訴同學」。receipt、weather、sugar 都不是地點。

gloss: 在球落地前把球打回去
passages.zh: 排球是 1895 年由威廉．摩根發明的，他是麻薩諸塞州霍利奧克市基督教青年會的體育老師。就在四年前，附近的城市才剛發明了籃球。但摩根覺得籃球對他班上一些年紀較大的生意人來說太激烈了。他想要一種比較少跑步、少推擠的運動。於是他在體育館裡把網子架高，讓球員用手把球打過網。一開始，他把這個遊戲叫做「Mintonette」，因為它有一點像羽球。後來，大家注意到球員把球在空中來回打（volley），所以名字就改成了「volleyball」。我是從學校圖書館的一本書上學到這件事的。我在教室裡告訴同學時，沒有人相信我。「Mintonette？聽起來像一種糖果！」湯尼說。

passages.title: 羽球的名字從哪裡來
passages.text: Badminton is very popular in Taiwan, but where does its name come from? Long ago, people in many countries played games with a shuttlecock. In the 1800s, the game became popular at Badminton House, a big country home in England that belonged to the Duke of Beaufort. People started to {1} the game by the name of the house. So the sport is named after a place, not a person! I found this fact while I was doing a report in the school {2}. The next day, I shared it with my PE class in the {3}. Our teacher was surprised. "I've played badminton for thirty years, and I never knew that," she said. Later, she told the story to our {4}, and he asked me to share it at the morning meeting on the {5}. Now everyone at school knows it.

blanks.why: call the game by the name of the house「用那棟房子的名字稱呼這個遊戲」。boil、cry、arrive 都不能表示「稱呼」。
doing a report in the school library「在學校圖書館做報告」。fever、cough、sugar 都不是地點。
my PE class in the gym「在體育館上的體育課」，羽球課在體育館。weather、receipt、pumpkin 都不是場地。
told the story to our principal「把故事告訴校長」，後面的 he asked me 也是指校長。noise、sugar、cough 都不能聽故事。
the morning meeting on the playground「在操場上舉行的朝會」。fever、weather、receipt 都不是開朝會的地方。

passages.zh: 羽球在台灣很受歡迎，但它的名字是從哪裡來的呢？很久以前，許多國家的人就會玩用羽毛球打來打去的遊戲。到了 1800 年代，這種遊戲在英國一座屬於波福公爵的鄉間大宅「伯明頓莊園」流行起來。人們開始用這棟房子的名字來稱呼這個遊戲。所以這項運動是以一個地方命名，不是以人命名！我是在學校圖書館做報告時發現這件事的。隔天，我在體育館上體育課時跟大家分享。老師很驚訝。「我打羽球三十年了，從來不知道這件事。」她說。後來她把這個故事告訴校長，校長請我在操場的朝會上分享。現在全校都知道了。

passages.title: 馬拉松為什麼是 42.195 公里
passages.text: A marathon is 42.195 kilometers long. Why such a strange number? At the 1908 Olympics in London, the race started at Windsor Castle and ended inside the Olympic stadium. That distance was 26 miles and 385 yards, or 42.195 kilometers. In 1921, it became the official distance for all marathons. Last month, our {1} had a crazy idea for Sports Day. "Let's run a marathon together, as a whole school!" The track around our {2} is 200 meters long, so one marathon is about 211 laps. No one could run that far alone, so every class became a team. Each student ran two or three laps, and then passed a ribbon to the next runner. When it started to rain, we moved into the {3} and kept running in circles. After five hours, the last runner finished. We were all so {4} that we went straight back to our {5} and fell asleep on our desks.

blanks.why: our principal had a crazy idea「校長有個瘋狂的點子」，後面說話的也是校長。pumpkin、sugar、noise 都不會想點子、說話。
the track around our playground「繞著操場的跑道」。fever、cough、receipt 周圍都不會有跑道。
moved into the gym「移到體育館裡」，下雨所以改到室內跑。weather、sugar、fever 都不是可以進去的場所。
so tired that「累到……」，跑完一整場馬拉松。salty（鹹的）、national（國家的）、crowded（擁擠的）都不能形容人累。
went back to our classroom and fell asleep on our desks「回到教室趴在桌上睡著」。cough、receipt、pumpkin 都不是可以回去的地方，也沒有書桌。

passages.zh: 馬拉松全長 42.195 公里。為什麼是這麼奇怪的數字？在 1908 年的倫敦奧運，賽跑從溫莎城堡出發，終點在奧運體育場裡面。那段距離是 26 英里又 385 碼，也就是 42.195 公里。1921 年，它成為所有馬拉松的正式距離。上個月，校長為運動會想了一個瘋狂的點子：「我們全校一起跑一場馬拉松吧！」我們操場的跑道一圈 200 公尺，所以一場馬拉松大約要跑 211 圈。沒有人能一個人跑那麼遠，所以每班組成一隊。每個學生跑兩三圈，再把緞帶交給下一位跑者。開始下雨後，我們移到體育館裡繼續繞圈跑。五個小時後，最後一位跑者跑完了。我們全都累到直接回教室，趴在桌上睡著了。

passages.title: 大腦只用了一成？
passages.text: Many people believe that we only use 10 percent of our brains. Some movies even show people who become super smart after they "open up" the other 90 percent. But scientists say this is a myth. Brain scans show that we use almost every part of our brain, and many parts are working even while we sleep. I {1} this in a science lesson last week. Before class, my friend Ben was sure he only used 10 percent of his brain. "That's why I'm bad at math," he said. Our teacher smiled and showed us brain pictures on the screen at the front of the {2}. Different parts lit up when people talked, moved, or listened to music. Ben was quiet for a moment. Then he said, "So I can't use the 90 percent as an excuse anymore?" After school, he went to the {3} and borrowed two math books. Our teacher told the {4} about it, and she was so happy that she wrote Ben a card. Now Ben reads in the library every day before he goes to the {5}.

blanks.why: learned this in a science lesson「在自然課學到這件事」。tasted、boiled、married 都不能和 this in a science lesson 搭配。
the front of the classroom「教室前面」，螢幕在教室前方。fever、sugar、receipt 都沒有「前面的螢幕」。
went to the library and borrowed two math books「去圖書館借了兩本數學書」。cough、noise、weather 都不是可以借書的地方。
told the principal「告訴校長」，後面 she wrote Ben a card 指的就是校長。pumpkin、fever、noise 都不能聽、不能寫卡片。
goes to the playground「去操場」玩。receipt、sugar、cough 都不是可以去的地方。

passages.zh: 很多人相信我們只用了大腦的一成。有些電影甚至演出有人「打開」另外九成之後變得超級聰明。但科學家說這是錯誤的說法。腦部掃描顯示，我們幾乎會用到大腦的每個部分，而且很多部分在我們睡覺時也在運作。我是上星期在自然課學到這件事的。上課前，我的朋友小班很確定他只用了一成的大腦。「所以我數學才那麼爛。」他說。老師笑了笑，在教室前面的螢幕上給我們看大腦的圖片。人在說話、活動或聽音樂時，大腦不同的部位會亮起來。小班安靜了一會兒，然後說：「所以我不能再拿那九成當藉口了？」放學後，他去圖書館借了兩本數學書。老師把這件事告訴校長，校長高興得寫了一張卡片給他。現在小班每天先在圖書館讀書，再去操場玩。

passages.title: 舌頭地圖是錯的
passages.text: For many years, school books showed a "tongue map." It said the tip of the tongue tastes sweet things, the back tastes bitter things, and the sides taste sour and salty things. But scientists now know this map is wrong. Taste buds on every part of the tongue can taste all the basic tastes. Some areas may be a little more sensitive, but the differences are very small. Last week, our science teacher let us test this in our {1}. We put sugar water on the back of our tongues, and it still tasted {2}. Then we tried lemon juice on the tip, and it was very {3}! Later, I found an old book in the school {4} with the tongue map in it. I showed it to our {5}. He laughed and said, "I learned that map when I was your age. I guess I have to learn again!"

blanks.why: test this in our classroom「在教室裡做實驗」。fever、weather、noise 都不是可以做實驗的地方。
tasted sweet「嚐起來是甜的」，糖水放在舌根還是甜的。careless（粗心的）、national（國家的）、crowded（擁擠的）都不能形容味道。
very sour「很酸」，檸檬汁是酸的。careless、national、polite（有禮貌的）都不能形容味道。
an old book in the school library「學校圖書館裡的舊書」。cough、receipt、pumpkin 裡面都不會有書。
showed it to our principal「拿給校長看」，後面 He laughed and said 指的是校長。sugar、weather、fever 都不能看書、說話。

passages.zh: 很多年來，課本上都有一張「舌頭地圖」。上面說舌尖嚐甜、舌根嚐苦、兩側嚐酸和鹹。但科學家現在知道這張地圖是錯的。舌頭每個部位的味蕾都嚐得到所有基本的味道。有些區域也許稍微敏感一點，但差別非常小。上星期，自然老師讓我們在教室裡做實驗。我們把糖水放在舌根，嚐起來還是甜的。接著我們把檸檬汁放在舌尖，酸得不得了！後來，我在學校圖書館找到一本印著舌頭地圖的舊書，拿給校長看。他笑著說：「我在你們這個年紀時學的就是這張地圖。看來我得重新學一次了！」

passages.title: 從太空看得到長城嗎
passages.text: Many people say that the Great Wall of China is the only human-made thing you can see from space. It sounds true, because the wall is thousands of kilometers long. But it is also very narrow, usually less than 10 meters wide, and its color is close to the color of the land around it. In 2003, Yang Liwei, China's first astronaut, said he could not see the wall from space. NASA also says it is very hard to see it with your eyes alone. Last month, our English teacher asked us to {1} if this fact was true or false. Almost everyone in the {2} said "true." Only my friend Mia said "false." She had read about it in a science magazine in the school {3}. The teacher gave her a prize. Later, our {4} heard about it and asked Mia to talk about it at the school science fair in the {5}.

blanks.why: guess if this fact was true「猜這件事是真是假」，guess + if 子句。boil、marry、bake 都不能接 if 子句。
everyone in the classroom「教室裡的每個人」。fever、cough、noise 裡面都不會有人。
a science magazine in the school library「學校圖書館裡的科學雜誌」。receipt、sugar、weather 都不是放雜誌的地方。
our principal heard about it「校長聽說了」，還請米亞去演講，主詞要是人。pumpkin、noise、cough 都不會聽說、邀請。
the school science fair in the gym「在體育館舉行的科展」。weather、fever、sugar 都不是辦活動的場地。

passages.zh: 很多人說，萬里長城是唯一從太空看得到的人造物。這聽起來很像真的，因為長城有好幾千公里長。但它也非常窄，通常不到 10 公尺寬，而且顏色和周圍土地的顏色很接近。2003 年，中國第一位太空人楊利偉說，他在太空看不到長城。美國太空總署也說，只用肉眼很難看到它。上個月，英文老師要我們猜這件事是真是假。教室裡幾乎每個人都說「真的」，只有我的朋友米亞說「假的」。她曾在學校圖書館的一本科學雜誌上讀過這件事。老師送給她一個小獎品。後來校長聽說了，請米亞在體育館舉辦的學校科展上介紹這件事。

passages.title: 金星的一天比一年還長
passages.text: On Earth, one day is much shorter than one year. But on Venus, it is the other way around. Venus turns very slowly. It takes about 243 Earth days to spin around once. But it takes only about 225 Earth days to go around the Sun. So a day on Venus is longer than a year! Also, Venus spins the opposite way from most planets, so the Sun rises in the west there. Our science club meets in the school {1} every Wednesday, and this was our topic last week. Jerry asked, "If I lived on Venus, would I have a birthday before my first day ended?" Everyone {2}. Then our teacher said, "Let's make a Venus calendar." We worked on it for two weeks and showed it at the school fair in the {3}. Our {4} loved it so much that he hung it on the wall of his office. Now it's also in our {5}, right next to the clock.

blanks.why: meets in the school library「在學校圖書館聚會」。fever、sugar、cough 都不是地點。
Everyone laughed「大家都笑了」，傑瑞的問題很好笑。borrowed、boiled、married 後面要接受詞，而且意思不合。
the school fair in the gym「在體育館辦的學校博覽會」。weather、receipt、pumpkin 都不是場地。
our principal loved it「校長很喜歡」，還掛在自己辦公室，主詞要是人。noise、cough、sugar 都不會喜歡、掛東西。
in our classroom, next to the clock「在我們教室裡，時鐘旁邊」。fever、weather、receipt 裡面都不會有時鐘。

passages.zh: 在地球上，一天比一年短得多。但在金星上卻正好相反。金星轉得非常慢，自轉一圈大約要 243 個地球日，但繞太陽一圈只要大約 225 個地球日。所以金星的一天比一年還長！而且金星自轉的方向和大部分行星相反，所以在那裡太陽是從西邊升起。我們的科學社每週三在學校圖書館聚會，上星期的主題就是這個。傑瑞問：「如果我住在金星，我是不是第一天還沒過完就先過生日了？」大家都笑了。接著老師說：「我們來做一份金星日曆吧。」我們做了兩個星期，在體育館的學校博覽會上展出。校長非常喜歡，把它掛在自己辦公室的牆上。現在我們教室裡也有一份，就掛在時鐘旁邊。

passages.title: 校長的冷笑話廣播
passages.text: Every Monday morning, our principal tells a joke on the school radio. Most of his jokes are so bad that the whole {1} goes quiet. Last Monday, he asked, "Why is the {2} the tallest building in town?" Nobody knew. "Because it has the most stories!" he said, and then he laughed at his own joke for ten seconds. In English, "story" can mean a tale in a book, and it can also mean a floor of a building. It took me a minute to {3} it. At lunch, my friends and I decided to get back at him. We wrote our own joke and gave it to the {4} in his office. The next Monday, he read it on the radio: "Why did the basketball player go to the {5} in his pajamas? Because he wanted to shoot some sleepy hoops!" This time, the whole school groaned even louder.

blanks.why: the whole classroom goes quiet「整間教室安靜下來」。fever、sugar、receipt 都不能說「整個……都安靜了」。
Why is the library the tallest building?「為什麼圖書館是最高的建築？」因為圖書館的 stories（故事／樓層）最多。cough、weather、noise 都不是建築物。
understand it「聽懂這個笑話」。boil、marry、arrive 都不能表示理解。
gave it to the principal in his office「拿去校長室給校長」。pumpkin、noise、fever 都沒有辦公室，也不能收笑話。
go to the gym「去體育館」投籃。sugar、weather、receipt 都不是打球的地方。

passages.zh: 每週一早上，校長都會在學校廣播講一個笑話。他的笑話大多冷到整間教室都安靜下來。上週一，他問：「為什麼圖書館是鎮上最高的建築？」沒有人知道。「因為它的 stories 最多！」他說完，自己笑了十秒。英文的 story 可以指書裡的故事，也可以指建築物的一層樓。我想了一分鐘才聽懂。午餐時，我和朋友決定回敬他。我們自己寫了一個笑話，送到校長室給他。下週一，他在廣播裡唸出來：「為什麼那個籃球員穿著睡衣去體育館？因為他想投幾個想睡的籃（sleepy hoops）！」這一次，全校的哀嚎聲更大了。

passages.title: 慢慢開的理由
passages.text: Tom was late for school again. When he finally walked into the {1}, it was already 8:20. "Why are you late this time?" asked Ms. Chen. "I'm sorry," Tom said. "I saw a sign on the road. It said, 'School ahead. Go slow.' So I walked very, very slowly." The class laughed, but Ms. Chen did not. She sent him to the {2}. The principal listened to the story and smiled. "Tom, that sign is for cars, not for students," he said. "Since you like signs so much, I have a job for you." For the next week, Tom had to come to school at 7:00 and make signs for the school. He made one for the {3} that said "Quiet, please," and one for the {4} that said "No food or drinks." His last sign was for the gate. It said, "School ahead. Walk fast!" Since then, he has never been {5} again.

blanks.why: walked into the classroom「走進教室」。fever、cough、sugar 都不是可以走進去的地方。
sent him to the principal「叫他去見校長」，後面 The principal listened 也是指校長。weather、pumpkin、noise 都不能聽學生說話。
a sign for the library that said "Quiet, please"「圖書館的『請保持安靜』告示」。fever、receipt、weather 都不需要掛這種告示。
a sign for the gym that said "No food or drinks"「體育館的『禁止飲食』告示」。sugar、cough、noise 都不是場所。
never been late again「再也沒遲到過」，和故事開頭遲到呼應。thirsty（口渴的）、salty（鹹的）、national（國家的）都不合文意。

passages.zh: 湯姆上學又遲到了。他終於走進教室時，已經八點二十分了。「這次為什麼遲到？」陳老師問。「對不起，」湯姆說，「我在路上看到一個告示牌，上面寫『前有學校，慢行』。所以我就走得非常、非常慢。」全班都笑了，但陳老師沒有笑。她叫湯姆去見校長。校長聽完他的說法後笑了。「湯姆，那個告示是給車子看的，不是給學生看的。」他說，「既然你這麼喜歡告示牌，我給你一個工作。」接下來的一週，湯姆每天七點就要到校，替學校做告示牌。他替圖書館做了一個「請保持安靜」，替體育館做了一個「禁止飲食」。他做的最後一個告示牌掛在校門口，上面寫著：「前有學校，快走！」從那以後，他再也沒遲到過。
